issues.description: The problem statement for Aufgabe 05 requests the average area (durchschnittliche Fläche) of Gemeinden per Landkreis (and the Landkreis name and Regierungsbezirk). The solution (solution_repository/aufgabe05.sql) uses COUNT(flaeche) instead of AVG(flaeche), so the reference solution returns a count of non-null area values rather than the requested average. This is a cross-artifact semantic/structural mismatch that will confuse students: the solution does not implement the aggregate operation specified in the task and therefore contradicts the exercise requirement.
issues.suggested_fix: Update the solution to compute the average area using AVG(flaeche) instead of COUNT(flaeche). For example: SELECT regierungsbezirk, kreis, AVG(flaeche) FROM Gemeinde GROUP BY regierungsbezirk, kreis ORDER BY kreis. This aligns the solution with the task description (durchschnittliche Fläche).
